resources.string: Drag across the picture to draw a straight cut. Horizontal, vertical and diagonal cuts are supported. Both pieces stay on the board.
Draw a line through the picture. You can redraw before confirming.
Two pieces ready. After splitting, tap a piece to move or split it again. Undo restores the original.
Could not split this picture. Try another line; both sides need visible content.
